meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 装上后,当你提供产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简报时,Claude 会把它做成产品发布或宣传视频:先更新技能、处理音频图片与商标,再按步骤捕获素材、设计方案、写故事板与脚本、逐帧生成动画,最后输出 MP4 视频。网站导览/展示类请求也走此流程。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布、宣传或展示某个产品,或给出商业网址,或要求做网站导览/展示视频时触发。不确定时转而走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 变成一条产品发布视频。
say.note: Claude 会捕获该网站并开始创建项目。

say.text: 按这段脚本给我们的 SaaS 做个功能展示视频。
say.note: 脚本会作为旁白底稿进入故事板流程。

say.text: 帮我们的 App 做一条启动宣传片,长度 30 秒。
say.note: 项目名取自品牌,进入短暂问答后开始制作。

howto.what_en: When you provide a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief, Claude turns it into a product launch or promo video: it updates the skill, resolves media, captures assets, designs, storyboards, animates frame by frame, and outputs an MP4. Site tour/showcase requests route here too.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; when you supply a commercial URL; or for site tours/showcases. If unclear, it falls back to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn https://example.com into a product launch video.
say_en.note: Claude captures the site and starts the project.

say_en.text: Make a feature reveal video for our SaaS from this script.
say_en.note: The script becomes the narration draft for the storyboard.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second launch promo for our app.
say_en.note: Project is named from the brand; brief gets locked before production.
